outcome_sought: Refund of £1,140 in costs caused by the late completion, an explanation of why the payment was held, compensation for distress and an apology.
rationale: The bank held a CHAPS payment past its requested value date and did not action its own verification task, so this is a late-executed payment under Parts 6-7 PSRs and the 15 business day clock applies (CP-3.2). The 2019 card complaint is more than twelve months old, so it is not a linked complaint, but the check itself is not recorded. The surname and new address hide inside the CHAPS reference, and the account number appears with a space in it.
